note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

csv.reason: TypeScript and Go still read a CSV document a line at a time through LinesSource and LineFormat, which parse each line with csv's grammar: ts/src/lines.ts loads '@tabnas/csv' (an optional peer) and go/lines.go imports github.com/tabnas/csv/go. Rust retired LinesSource and LineFormat in step 12 of alchemy's streaming plan (tabnas/transduce#66): a host reads CSV through csv's transducer part, alchemy's transduce-records, which the Rust routers run natively (tabnas/transduce#65). So in Rust tabnas-csv is only a dev-dependency, for the tests that read CSV (tabnas/transduce#67).
csv.repair: Step 12 in the ports. Once TypeScript and Go read CSV through csv's part and retire LinesSource and LineFormat, ts/package.json and go/go.mod drop csv as a runtime dependency. That is a dependency change, made on the maintainer's instruction (ADR-22), and this entry goes with it.

json.reason: TypeScript and Go still read a JSON Lines document a line at a time through LinesSource and LineFormat, which parse each line with JSON's grammar: ts/src/lines.ts loads '@tabnas/json' (an optional peer), and go/lines.go and go/rule_events.go's jsonlIncremental import github.com/tabnas/json/go. Rust retired LinesSource and LineFormat in step 12 of alchemy's streaming plan (tabnas/transduce#66): a host reads JSON Lines through jsonl's transducer part. So in Rust tabnas-json is only a dev-dependency, for the tests that read JSON (tabnas/transduce#67).
json.repair: Step 12 in the ports. Once TypeScript and Go read JSON Lines through jsonl's part and retire LinesSource and LineFormat, ts/package.json and go/go.mod drop json as a runtime dependency. That is a dependency change, made on the maintainer's instruction (ADR-22), and this entry goes with it.
